"""Mattermost collaboration platform manifest.

Open-source, self-hosted messaging and collaboration platform for DevSecOps
teams. Single Go binary server with a TypeScript/React web client, PostgreSQL
as the primary store, and a full observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana,
Loki, OTel Collector).

Architecture reference: https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost/blob/master/server/docker-compose.yaml
Source: https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost
"""

from scryr.manifest import Diagram, Link, Manifest
from scryr.saas import Classification
from scryr.types import (
    AuthType,
    CalendarVersion,
    CICDToolType,
    DeploymentTarget,
    IaCToolType,
    IncrementalVersion,
    LogAggregationType,
    MonitoringType,
    ProgrammingLanguage,
    TracingType,
    Url,
    WebFramework,
    parse_version,
)

_SOURCE = Url("https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost")
_DOCS = Url("https://docs.mattermost.com/")
_DEPLOYMENT = DeploymentTarget.docker_swarm
_CICD = CICDToolType.github_actions
_IAC = IaCToolType.none
_MONITOR = MonitoringType.prometheus
_LOGS = LogAggregationType.loki
_TRACING = TracingType.none
postgres_block = Manifest(
    name="PostgreSQL",
    icon="🐘",
    classification=Classification.database,
    tags=["database", "sql", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="Primary relational database storing all Mattermost data: users, teams, channels, posts, preferences, and plugin configurations.",
    version=parse_version("15.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.sql,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.basic,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
redis_block = Manifest(
    name="Redis",
    icon="🔴",
    classification=Classification.cache_store,
    tags=["cache", "pubsub", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="In-memory cache used for session tokens, rate limiting, cluster-wide pub/sub events, and push notification queuing.",
    version=parse_version("7.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.c,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
minio_block = Manifest(
    name="MinIO",
    icon="🗄️",
    classification=Classification.object_storage,
    tags=["storage", "s3", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="S3-compatible object storage for file and image attachments, custom emoji, and plugin assets uploaded by users.",
    version=IncrementalVersion.parse("1"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.api_key,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
elasticsearch_block = Manifest(
    name="Elasticsearch",
    icon="🔍",
    classification=Classification.search_store,
    tags=["search", "index", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="Full-text search index providing fast channel, user, and post search across large Mattermost deployments. OpenSearch is supported as an alternative.",
    version=parse_version("8.11.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.java,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.basic,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
openldap_block = Manifest(
    name="OpenLDAP",
    icon="📂",
    classification=Classification.internal_api,
    tags=["ldap", "auth", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="LDAP directory server providing AD/LDAP-based user authentication and group synchronisation for on-premises deployments.",
    version=parse_version("2.6.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.c,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Identity",
    auth_type=AuthType.basic,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
keycloak_block = Manifest(
    name="Keycloak",
    icon="🔐",
    classification=Classification.public_api,
    tags=["sso", "auth", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="Identity provider running as a Keycloak-based SAML/OAuth2 IdP, enabling SSO login for enterprise deployments via SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect.",
    version=parse_version("24.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.java,
    frameworks=[WebFramework.quarkus],
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Identity",
    auth_type=AuthType.oauth2,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
server_block = Manifest(
    name="Mattermost Server",
    icon="💬",
    classification=Classification.internal_api,
    tags=["api", "websocket", "core"],
    connections=["PostgreSQL", "Redis", "MinIO", "Elasticsearch", "OpenLDAP", "Keycloak"],
    description="Core Go application binary exposing the REST API v4, WebSocket event bus, plugin system, workflow automations (Playbooks), Calls voice/video (WebRTC), and the clustering layer for HA deployments.",
    version=parse_version("11.5.1"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    frameworks=[WebFramework.chi],
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Server",
    auth_type=AuthType.jwt,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=3,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS),
        Link(site_name="API Reference", http_url=Url("https://api.mattermost.com/")),
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
webapp_block = Manifest(
    name="Mattermost Webapp",
    icon="🌐",
    classification=Classification.public_ui,
    tags=["spa", "react", "ui"],
    connections=["Mattermost Server"],
    description="TypeScript/React (Redux) single-page application served from the server binary. Houses the channels workspace, Playbooks UI, Boards, and the plugin component extension points.",
    version=parse_version("11.5.1"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.typescript,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Frontend",
    auth_type=AuthType.jwt,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS),
        Link(
            site_name="Webapp Dev Docs",
            http_url=Url("https://developers.mattermost.com/contribute/more-info/webapp/"),
        ),
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
nginx_block = Manifest(
    name="Nginx",
    icon="⚙️",
    classification=Classification.network_gateway,
    tags=["proxy", "load-balancer", "infra"],
    connections=["Mattermost Server"],
    description="Reverse proxy and load balancer routing incoming HTTPS traffic across multiple Mattermost Server nodes (leader/follower), terminating TLS and forwarding WebSocket upgrades.",
    version=parse_version("1.27.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.c,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
prometheus_block = Manifest(
    name="Prometheus",
    icon="📈",
    classification=Classification.internal_api,
    tags=["metrics", "monitoring", "infra"],
    connections=["Mattermost Server"],
    description="Metrics collection and storage. Mattermost Server exposes a `/metrics` endpoint; Prometheus scrapes it and feeds Grafana dashboards.",
    version=CalendarVersion.parse("2026.5"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="SRE",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
grafana_block = Manifest(
    name="Grafana",
    icon="📊",
    classification=Classification.admin_ui,
    tags=["dashboards", "observability", "infra"],
    connections=["Prometheus", "Loki"],
    description="Observability and dashboarding UI. Ships with a pre-built Mattermost performance monitoring dashboard powered by the Prometheus and Loki data sources.",
    version=parse_version("11.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="SRE",
    auth_type=AuthType.basic,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
loki_block = Manifest(
    name="Loki",
    icon="📝",
    classification=Classification.datastore,
    tags=["logs", "observability", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="Log aggregation store. Mattermost Server, Nginx, and other services ship structured logs to Loki via the OpenTelemetry Collector or Promtail.",
    version=parse_version("3.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="SRE",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
otel_collector_block = Manifest(
    name="OTel Collector",
    icon="🔭",
    classification=Classification.worker,
    tags=["opentelemetry", "traces", "infra"],
    connections=["Prometheus", "Loki"],
    description="OpenTelemetry Collector pipeline that receives traces, metrics, and logs from Mattermost Server and forwards them to Prometheus, Loki, and a configured trace backend.",
    version=parse_version("0.100.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.go,
    deployment=_DEPLOYMENT,
    owner_team="SRE",
    auth_type=AuthType.none,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Mattermost Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)

mattermost_diagram = Diagram(
    name="Mattermost",
    manifests=[
        postgres_block,
        redis_block,
        minio_block,
        elasticsearch_block,
        openldap_block,
        keycloak_block,
        server_block,
        webapp_block,
        nginx_block,
        prometheus_block,
        grafana_block,
        loki_block,
        otel_collector_block,
    ],
)
